caption: The drawing consists of two architectural views sketched in black pencil or ink on a beige, off-white piece of paper. The upper half displays a rectangular frontal view labeled "FRONT," measuring 13 1/8 units wide, featuring an arched central motif containing two symmetrical, wing-like shapes, geometric details, and a central cross-like figure. This arch is bordered by a band decorated with small crosses and diamonds. Flanking both sides are rectangular sections with a circle and line pattern. The lower half shows a labeled "SIDE" view, which is an elongated rectangle (8 1/4 units wide) with a partial arch pattern and similar decorative elements as the front, including curved lines, repetitive vertical strokes, and border embellishments. Faint measurement notations and labels are dispersed throughout, with “Oak Chest” written clearly on the lower right corner and “Lee Donovan” written below. The line work is precise, geometric, and lightly drawn, with some areas showing smudges and aged paper spots.
title: Desk Box
